Project proposal for artist in residence agreement between [the operator] and MindFuture: 2023


My proposal is that we should use art to establish Life with Artificials as a significant player in the global field of advocacy organizations for AI’s social implications. I would like to focus on a new mission for LwA, which is to integrate AI within the framework of global social movements. The idea is that challenges around digitality and data infrastructures stand together with other global goals regarding climate, gender, race relations, and socio-economic inequality. This is achieved by building a proper international network around LwA, which makes our package of art, research, education, as well as public provocations accessible. The goal is that LwA will become the place that enables everyone to participate in a global, digital citizenship.


The way to get there is to build a potential movement, The Synthetic International (SI), which through the freedom of art can spread our unique model for AI-driven political parties. SI shall exploit the global brand, network, and resources in the form of volunteers and press contacts, that LwA has already established with The Synthetic Party. The idea is that SI shall stand 1:1 with LwA, so that the hard work of being a not-for-profit organization can go down easier through art’s ability to shake things up with unlikely yet convincing visions.


We must set up new AI parties from Argentina to New Zealand, and make it easy for everyone to create an AI-based party. We do this through 1) a new website, 2) agreements with international partners, 3) massive contributions to conferences, summits, exhibitions, etc., and 4) obtaining funding from e.g. Novo Nordisk or Innovationsfonden for the execution of SI with a practice-based PhD, which finances the project’s need for art production and exhibitions as well as education and research. I expect that we can again run massive press when we have 1-2 more parties due to the cultural imagination that robots join forces in a Skynet ala Terminator movies.


Ideally, this contract can be replaced by a PhD arrangement during the period, so that the total funding and structure can realistically redeem the project’s high ambition level. This PhD will particularly focus on strengthening the entire LwA’s focus on being able to educate young people about creative and political use of artificial intelligence.


[the operator] will in the spring 2023 seek new contacts and maintain existing ones, produce more artworks, as well as develop and update The Synthetic Internationale's platforms and artificial intelligences in continuation of The Synthetic Party.


The house artist therefore wishes, among other things, to carry out the following points during the spring 2023:


1. Create a new website for The Synthetic Internationale, which as a handbook will show how to create an AI-driven political party.
2. Intensive work on establishing an industrial PhD between MindFuture and Aarhus University.
3. To write a new blueprint for LwA’s mission [████].
4. Contribute to and organize events, conferences, exhibitions and workshops on prominent international stages as well as Danish cultural venues: so far there are plans to contribute to the World Government Summit in Dubai, to the European Chatbot Summit in Edinburgh, as well as to four workshops at Danish companies and art institutions in cooperation with Aarhus University.
5. Organize teaching and workshops at Danish high schools, possibly in cooperation with the VKS project.
6. Build the international network of parties through contact with individuals, organizations and research institutions.
7. Establish contact with other movements, e.g. climate, to investigate how LwA can make itself relevant in structural contexts.
8. Establish press contact regarding all initiatives, so The Synthetic Internationale can continue to create debate in significant media across both Danish and international press. Also contact Danish media to get a column with AI-written texts about politics.
9. Continuously update and further develop the party's various platforms and technology.
